question: "One Life is Not Enough" is written by which of the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K. Natwar Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **K. Natwar Singh** was an **Indian politician, diplomat and author. **
 
• **"One Life is Not Enough"** is his autobiography, which was published in** 2014.**
 
• In this book, he has shared his experiences as a **politician and diplomat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jhumpa Lahiri** is an **Indian-American author,** who is known for her works of fiction, such as** "Interpreter of Maladies" and "The Namesake".**
 
• **Faraz Ahmad **is an Indian journalist and author, who has written books on **politics and society. **
 
• **Khushwant Singh** was an Indian author and journalist, who wrote books on a wide range of topics, such as **history, politics, religion and culture**.
 
 
• He has written books like **"Train to Pakistan", "I Shall Not Hear the Nightingale" and "Delhi".**
